rules.name: recon-trades-05-consumer-view-v4-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT p.business_unit, p.settlement_date, r.resolved_value_date, r.status, r.row_count, r.requested_at, p.published_at FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p JOIN opera.recon_refresh_run r ON r.uuid = p.published_run_id WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.business_unit = :bu AND p.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING' AND p.settlement_date = :settlementDate

WITH s AS ( SELECT h.trade_id, h.source_trade_id, h.nc_factor, h.fx_nc_factor, h.invenio_product_code, h.product_name, h.exchange_name FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit = :bu AND h.settlement_date = :settlementDate ), c AS ( SELECT DISTINCT trade_id::text AS trade_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu ) SELECT count(*) AS row_count, count(s.source_trade_id) AS has_source_trade_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.trade_id = s.source_trade_id || '-' || CAST(:bu AS text)) AS suffix_rule_ok, count(s.nc_factor) AS has_nc_factor, count(s.fx_nc_factor) AS has_fx_nc_factor, count(s.invenio_product_code) AS has_product_code, count(c.trade_id) AS source_id_found_in_live_cloned FROM s LEFT JOIN c ON c.trade_id = s.source_trade_id

SELECT count(*) AS consumer_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE mtm_usd IS NULL) AS mtm_usd_null, count(*) FILTER (WHERE fx_nc_factor IS NULL) AS fx_nc_factor_null, sum(mtm_nc) AS sum_mtm_nc, sum(mtm_usd) AS sum_mtm_usd FROM opera.helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu AND settlement_date = :settlementDate AND subportfolio = :subportfolio

SELECT v.trade_id, v.asset_class, v.invenio_product_code, v.product_name, v.exchange_name, v.lot_mult1, v.curr_mult1, v.mult_factor, v.nc_factor, v.fx_nc_factor, v.mtm_nc, v.mtm_usd FROM opera.helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND v.business_unit = :bu AND v.settlement_date = :settlementDate AND v.subportfolio = :subportfolio

SELECT h.trade_id, sp.asset_class, sp.invenio_product_code, sp.product_name, sp.exchange_name, sp.lot_mult1::double precision AS lot_mult1, sp.curr_mult1::double precision AS curr_mult1, sp.mult_factor::double precision AS mult_factor, sp.nc_factor::double precision AS nc_factor, fx.fx_nc_factor::double precision AS fx_nc_factor, (((h.settle_price * h.active_lots) - (h.current_premium * h.active_lots)) * sp.mult_factor)::double precision AS mtm_nc, (((((h.settle_price * h.active_lots) - (h.current_premium * h.active_lots)) * sp.mult_factor) * sp.nc_factor) * fx.fx_nc_factor)::double precision AS mtm_usd FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h LEFT JOIN opera.helper_settle_pricing_and_traders_pricing_view sp ON sp.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND sp.business_unit = h.business_unit AND sp.security_id = h.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.fx_nc_factor_view fx ON fx.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND fx.business_unit = h.business_unit AND fx.trade_id = h.source_trade_id WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit = :bu AND h.settlement_date = :settlementDate AND h.subportfolio = :subportfolio

expect.reason: the settle snapshot of the date must be published by exactly one refresh run
the v4 builder filled source_trade_id on every row of the published snapshot
trade_id is exactly source_trade_id plus the BU suffix on every row
every source_trade_id exists in cloned_deal_ticket_table: the key the views must join on is correct
the consumer view returns rows for the subportfolio
the v4 consumer view returns the same trades and the same factors and amounts as the pricing view and the live fx view joined on source_trade_id
